notes.title: Ancient Russian Life Simulator + Update + Incoming Sale
notes.content:
Update
We have released an update to prepare you for the release of the prequel to Russian Life Simulator - Ancient Russian Life Simulator, which will tell about the greatest exploits of the ancient Rus in the war against lizards, will allow you to use the most famous techniques of the ancient Rus and receive the blessing of the gods! And of course, MASSACRE THE GODLY LIZARDS!
The game's release is scheduled for December 15, 2023, but you can download the update for Russian Life Simulator now!
Sale
We are also planning to launch a 50% discount for Russian Life Simulator on December 13th, so you can play the original part before the prequel releases!

To be ready add to wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701910/Ancient_Russian_Life_Simulator/

notes.title: Halloween event!
notes.content:
This year we have prepared a really big update for you with a Halloween event!
Main innovation:
The main goal of the Halloween event will be to hunt ghosts - quilted jackets that inhabit all locations of the game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/dfc57f3b439720f7a6e1ab85d2d17cd62460e321.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/10792be70a62e524970385a3dd2fef41d4e09f05.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/1745281d960132c7849718f20c56c1caf064ca84.png
Details:
As befits a clicker, to catch them you need to click on them 10 times, after which the ghost will disappear and give you a terrifying gift or in-game currency. After capturing 10 ghosts, you will unlock that ghost as a playable character!
Design:
We have added Halloween decorations to all available locations in the game, it includes original Russian pumpkins and bats!
Date:
The event will be held from October 24 20:00 to November 2 20:00
Warning:
Beware of the ghost of the military commissar, he might have a surprise for you!

notes.content:
multiplayer  was added to the game, so now you can play Russian Life Simulator with the whole family! notes.title: Global update!
notes.content:
A global update for Russian Life Simulatora has already been released, a lot of new, interesting content has been added to the game. After reaching a pension of 20,000, a button will appear in the upper left corner, by clicking on which Vladimir Vladimirovich will turn to you for help.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34987081/5c1880e649a52df85faa1bc0104927d04e4db14a.png

The update contains:
[olist]
 Continuation of the plot story about the life of a Russian
 New locations
 New clothes
 New items in the store
 New sounds
 New game events
 Ability to start the game from the very beginning
 Halloween decoration of locations
 Various improvements and bug fixes
[/olist]

I also remind you that the game recently released collection cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges, which you can get by simply playing!
